protocol.primaryMetric: monotonic time from fetching status callback to synthesizing status callback; ms
protocol.comparison: unchanged ResearchRunner: FIFO-gated CapabilityExecutor (one active call) vs native worker pool (four)
protocol.synthesis: local deterministic synthesizer AFTER primary timing; no remote LLM
protocol.order: alternate serial/parallel order by (round + caseIndex) parity; rotate case order each round
protocol.eligibility: only matched pairs where BOTH runs and all capabilities succeed AND all semantic payload checks pass
protocol.failures: every attempt retained; no retries, replacement, or selective deletion
protocol.payloadStorage: public normalized data snapshots stored for equivalence audit; no auth/status output or account data
protocol.caseSelection: Before paired measurement: comprehensive NVDA preflight failed market.intraday and research.events. Chose value/risk-review/growth presets using available capabilities; failures remain in separate preflight artifacts. No full-comprehensive or event-driven success claim.
